seo.title: Hydro-Plus Hydronic Heating Expansion Tank | Closed Heating System | AQUASKY
seo.description: AQUASKY Hydro-Plus hydronic expansion tanks are designed for closed loop heating and cooling systems to absorb water thermal expansion. High-quality butyl diaphragm.

about.heading: Hydro-Plus Hydronic Heating Tanks
about.body: Hydro-Plus Hydronic Expansion tanks are designed to absorb the expanded fluid in closed-loop of residential or commercial hydronic heating and cooling systems to control pressure build up. Hydro-Plus expansion are tanks composed of a tank in sheet steel which in compliance with IAPMO and EN Standard and welded according to ASME & EN procedure by certified welder. The diaphragm is made with high temperature resistance EPDM rubber. All models are subject to hydraulic test with a pressure of 1.5 times higher than the design pressure. Hydro-Plus Expansion tank is the best safety choice for your Hydronic Heating system.
